gate_definitions.G0: Source and data identity, provenance and split audit
gate_definitions.G1: Teacher scope, coverage and independent source fidelity
gate_definitions.G2: 768D producer contract and reference numerical evidence
gate_definitions.G3: Short-context fidelity: teacher parity plus absolute accuracy, or separately preregistered absolute reference-supervised gate
gate_definitions.G5: Full local package compatibility and resource budget; WP09 provides resource evidence, WP10 completes package evidence

evaluation_protocol.canary_group_relationship: Record actual relationship; canaries sharing test groups do not add independent group count
evaluation_protocol.prior_exposed_panels: Regression only; never independent final selection evidence
evaluation_protocol.student_final_cohort: Remains sealed during teacher repairs and student selection
evaluation_protocol.cross_split_connected_groups: Quarantine without rewriting established split membership
evaluation_protocol.fitting_and_selection_supervision_export: Train/validation only; sealed evaluation never joins export
evaluation_protocol.reference_prefix_logits: Target-conditioned training evidence; targets and reference prefixes absent at generated inference
evaluation_protocol.sequence_kd_compatibility: Same canonical prefix, output codec and token identities required; raw versus grammar-masked distributions recorded; no timestep alignment across different output tokenizations
